#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys, re
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
from gen_catalog_owners import collect, OUT, _URL, HEADER
collected = collect()
rendered = (lambda owners: HEADER + "".join(f'    "{o}",\n' for o in owners) + "})\n")(collected)
committed = OUT.read_text()

# Find differences
lines_committed = committed.splitlines()
lines_rendered = rendered.splitlines()

committed_owners = set()
m = re.compile(r'"([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)"')
for line in lines_committed:
    for owner in m.findall(line):
        if owner != "GitHub" and owner not in ("do", "edit", "uwu", "Regenerate", "with"):
            pass
    owners_line = []
m2 = re.compile(r'"([^"]+)"')

from scripts.gen_catalog_owners import collect, OUT as OUT_PATH
collected_set = set(collect())
committed_set = set()
for line in committed.splitlines():
    for o in m2.findall(line):
        if o not in ("GitHub", "owners", "of", "tools", "we", "already", "ship",
                     "GENERATED", "do", "not", "edit", "Regenerate", "with",
                     "catalog_owners.py", "frozenset"):
            committed_set.add(o)

print("Collected count:", len(collected_set))
print("Committed count:", len(committed_set))
print()
only_in_collected = collected_set - committed_set
only_in_committed = committed_set - collected_set
if only_in_collected:
    print(f"Only in collected ({len(only_in_collected)}):")
    for o in sorted(only_in_collected):
        print(f"  + {o}")
if only_in_committed:
    print(f"\nOnly in committed ({len(only_in_committed)}):")
    for o in sorted(only_in_committed):
        print(f"  - {o}")

# Check what files are being scanned
from pathlib import Path
SRC = OUT_PATH.parents[1] / "src" / "hackingtool"
print("\n=== Scanning files for github.com patterns ===")
count = 0
for p in sorted(SRC.rglob("*")):
    if p.suffix in (".yaml", ".py") and p.is_file():
        text = p.read_text(errors="ignore")
        found = _URL.findall(text)
        valid_owners = [o for o in found if o.lower() not in _NOT_OWNERS]
        if valid_owners:
            count += 1
            print(f"\n{p.relative_to(SRC).as_posix()} ({p.suffix}):")
            for o in sorted(set(valid_owners)):
                status = "KNOWN" if o in committed_set else "MISSING_FROM_COMMITTED"
                if o in collected_set:
                    if o not in committed_set:
                        status = "***ADDED***"
                else:
                    status = "---NOT IN COLLECTION---"
                print(f"  [{status}] {o}")
print(f"\nTotal files scanned with valid owners: {count}")
